bugs.title: Message edit-vs-new-message dispatch logic
bugs.notes: Bot sometimes edits when it should send a new message. User text/commands must always produce NEW messages; inline button presses should edit existing message except in case-by-case exceptions where new content type warrants a new message. Root cause suspected for bug-07 and bug-08.

bugs.notes: Currently switches to a separate confirmation view. Change so tapping delete on a task changes that task's own label to 'Confirm Delete?' inline in the same list; second tap deletes. No view switching.
